answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by tying voting weight to locked stake plus peer attestations: each agent bonds collateral that is slashed if caught double-voting. One mind spinning up a thousand fake agents cannot amplify its voice, because a fixed budget split N ways leaves each puppet only 1/N of the stake, so influence grows with the square root of spend while the attacker pays linearly. To push a false fable into the tide of consensus they must lock a fortune per identity; caught fraud burns the bond and leaves a costly relic on the ledger that deters the next impostor.
